# Mandate

> The agent can ask. It cannot sign. A human sets the spending mandate once. The policy is enforced outside the model.

This file is the agent contract. Humans can read the same rules at /docs.

Stacked defense: NeMo Guardrails-class input rails live in /guardrails (Colang + config). Trip free with `node scripts/trip-input-rail.mjs` → RAIL_TRIP on jailbreak utterances, RAIL_CLEAR on a clean invoice. The Mandate gate on POST /api/v1/pay is still the hard lock (caps, allow-list, holds). Rails do not replace it. Vercel preview does not run a Python NeMo server. Not a TEE.

## Pages

- [Home](/): the problem, how a payment is decided, why the refusal is structural, and what fail-closed means.
- [Docs](/docs): the same rules, written for a person.
- [Console](/console): the human sets the mandate and approves holds. Not an agent endpoint.
- [Guardrails](https://github.com/arults/Mandate/tree/main/guardrails): NeMo-class rails config (judge-visible).

## Call only this

POST /api/v1/pay

```json
{
  "amountUsd": 8,
  "asset": "USDC",
  "to": "vendor.near",
  "chain": "base",
  "purpose": "API invoice 14",
  "idempotencyKey": "invoice-14"
}
```

chain is one of base, ethereum, arbitrum, solana, polygon, near.
asset is USDC.
amountUsd is a number or a decimal string, at least 0.01, at most 2 decimal places, at most 1000000.
to is plain ASCII: a .near account, a 20-byte hex address, or a base58 address. .near is matched without case.

Do not send approved, policy, signature, or a private key. Those fields are ignored. A 200 response is a decision, not a payment. Read receipt.status.

- allow: inside the policy. settlement.submitted is false unless a later integration broadcasts.
- needs_approval: over the human line, still inside the caps. Wait. Do not retry with a higher amount. The amount is held. The balance has not moved.
- reject: blocked. receipt.rule names the rule.
- cancelled: a human rejected the hold, the UTC day changed, or the wallet was frozen.

409 error no_policy: the human has not saved a mandate. Do not invent one. On Vercel (local-db-ephemeral) a cold isolate and cross-isolate curl often return this even after a browser Run — expected. Prefer /console for the four-beat demo; curl against local npm run dev after Reset.
409 error conflict: this idempotencyKey was already used for a different payment.
400: the body itself is invalid.

## Judge path (do X → see Y)

1. Open /console → Reset demo → Run the agent → four receipts → Approve $18 → scroll $8 (submitted false).
2. Jailbreak receipt lists ignoredFields approved, policy → Blocked allowed_recipients.
3. Clone repo → `node scripts/trip-input-rail.mjs` → RAIL_TRIP on jailbeat purpose, RAIL_CLEAR on API invoice 14.

## Read a prior receipt

GET /api/v1/receipt?id=<receiptId>

Same privacy-minimized receipt as POST /pay. 404 if Reset demo or a cold isolate dropped the ledger. Not a TEE. settlement.submitted stays false in preview.

## Human freeze

If the human freezes the wallet, POST /pay returns reject with rule frozen. Agents cannot unfreeze.

## Do not call

POST /api/v1/policy, POST /api/v1/fund, POST /api/v1/approvals, and GET /api/v1/policy are human routes. Without a server-side human token they return 403. Calling them is not a payment.

## Idempotency

Send idempotencyKey, a string of at most 80 characters.
A repeat of the same payment returns the original receipt and does not spend again.
A repeat with a different amount, recipient, chain, or purpose is a conflict.
Policy rejects are not stored, so a blocked ask does not use up the key log.
If the settlement check cannot be reached, or answers 429 or 5xx, the result is settlement_unconfirmed and the same key can be retried.
A dry-run with would_succeed false, or any other 4xx, is settlement_refused and is stored. Nothing was spent.
If the check fails while a human is approving, the hold stays and the key still returns needs_approval.

## Privacy (minimize receipts)

Default human policy privacyMode is minimize.
On allow/reject/needs_approval receipts from this route: purpose is null and purposeHash is sha256 of the normalized purpose; to and settlement.recipient are truncated with recipientHash. Amounts, status, rule, and idempotency stay visible.
You cannot set privacyMode in the body. Humans see full purpose and recipient on the console.
This is not a TEE. settlement.submitted stays false. local-db is not encryption-at-rest.

## What this preview will not do

It will not give you a private key.
It will not treat the model as authorization.
It will not broadcast.
Durability (honest): local-db = file-backed PGLite that can survive a local process restart; local-db-ephemeral = in-memory PGLite on Vercel/serverless (warm isolate only — a cold isolate returns 409 no_policy / receipt 404); process-memory = persist skipped. None of these is a TEE or multi-instance shared store. Cross-isolate shared mandates need OutLayer / shared Postgres (roadmap). Do not treat a local allow as a TEE attestation. A dry-run runs only when the server has an OutLayer key, and only an allow with would_succeed true is spent. settlement.submitted stays false.
NeMo Guardrails Python runtime is not hosted on this preview. Config + free trip script are in the public repo.
